decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted and numbered K1570/V/03, 04, 05, 07, 08, 09, 10, Received 29 November 2010Flood Risk Assessment (#1469), Received 1 October 2010K1570/V/06A, Received 6 January 2011, therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is occupied).

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The development hereby permitted shall only be carried out in accordance with the approved Flood Risk Assessment #1469, Received 1 October 2010and the basement shall not be occupied until all the measures in the Flood Risk Assessment are implemented.

Condition : 6 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 0800 to 1800 on Mondays to Friday and 0800 to 1300 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The windows formed within the roof on both the northern and southern elevations shall be obscure glazed to a minimum level of 3. The windows shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glass.

Condition : 8 - The dwelling shall not be occupied until a scheme has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority a plan indicating the positions, design, materials and type of boundary treatment and front garden treatment to be erected. The planting and treatment shall be completed in accordance with a timetable agreed in writing as part of the condition. Development shall be carried out with the approved details.

Condition : 9 - No excavation or construction work shall be undertaken prior to the submission and approval in writing by the Local Planning Authority, of a Construction Method Statement, which is certified by a qualified professional, giving specific details of excavation, temporary works and construction techniques, including details of potential impacts on neighbouring land based on assessment of the geology and hydrology of the area.
Condition : 10 - The basement shall at no time be used or occupied as a separate dwelling independent of the main house and shall not be used as sleeping accommodation.
description: Erection of a single storey side and rear extension, a rear roof extension and front roof extension above second floor bay window, increased height of party wall with No 45, a basement extension with front lightwell and alterations to the existing openings and front facade of the house.
